claims: As of April 1, 2026, the Artemis II Orion capsule is in high Earth orbit.
The Artemis II Orion capsule launched successfully from Kennedy Space Center.
The Artemis II crew consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II crew are performing systems checks.
The Artemis II crew are preparing for a maneuver to send them toward the Moon.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II spacecraft separated from the upper stage (ICPS).
The Artemis II spacecraft is preparing to conduct further burns to set its trajectory toward the Moon.
Artemis II crew members are reported safe.
Artemis II crew members are witnessing views of Earth from orbit.
The Artemis II crew will conduct a proximity operations demonstration to test manual maneuvering of the Orion capsule.
The Artemis II crew will conduct the proximity operations demonstration before starting the transit to the Moon.
The total Artemis II mission is expected to last 9.5 to 10 days.
